none: PAS LIN-931E67: Pierced roman coin used as a pendant
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Late Roman copper alloy nummus pierced and re-used as a pendant. The piercing is at the bottom left of the neck on the obverse, and at the bottom right of the camp gate on the reverse. The coin is of Constantine. Obverse: diademed bust right. Reverse: Campgate with two turrets. Legend reads PROVIDENTIAE AVGG. Mint mark: SCO[ ]
